provenance: hand-authored VKPower Life proving ground for VKPower Verdict

auth_recipe.note: Multi-step ladder: member number + password, then optional 6-digit MFA PIN.

e2e_flow_depth: 19 steps (login → quote → apply → confirm) — within E2E mode's 20-step budget
critical_scenarios: member logs in via member-number + password + PIN and reaches the dashboard
dashboard shows the member's own name, policy number and coverage (member-derived)
beneficiaries page lists the member's beneficiaries (count varies by member)
quote flow: select product → coverage → personal info → health screen → review with estimated premium
application flow: member lookup auto-populates profile → personal info → replacement policies
health questionnaire: ~150 questions across 14 categories with conditional follow-ups (Yes reveals sub-questions)
lifestyle questions: tobacco, alcohol, drugs, DUI, aviation, skydiving, scuba, combat deployment with conditional drill-downs
underwriting decision engine: evaluates health+lifestyle→approved/referred/declined with risk classification and reasons
payment: ACH bank transfer or credit/debit card with conditional form fields
beneficiary designation: primary + contingent with percentage allocation (must total 100%)
electronic signature: 6 consent checkboxes + typed name must match legal name
confirmation: application number + confirmation number generated, policy summary, next steps
conditional_ui_patterns: health questionnaire: Yes answer reveals 3 follow-up questions (date, treatment, status); No clears them
cancer section: Yes reveals staging, treatment type, remission status sub-questions
diabetes section: Yes reveals HbA1c level, complications sub-questions
lifestyle tobacco: Yes reveals product type + frequency selects
lifestyle alcohol: Yes reveals drinks-per-week + treatment history
lifestyle DUI: Yes reveals conviction count + most recent date
lifestyle aviation: Yes reveals pilot type + annual flight hours
lifestyle scuba: Yes reveals deep/cave diving follow-up
payment method: ACH shows bank fields; Card shows cardholder/number/expiry/CVV
personal info insured: No (different person) reveals insured person fields
replacement: Yes reveals add-policy form with company, number, face amount, reason

underwriting_paths.maria_young_25: Preferred Plus (healthy young officer, no conditions) → approved
underwriting_paths.james_torres_29: Preferred/Standard (enlisted, depends on health/lifestyle answers) → approved
underwriting_paths.robert_mitchell_48: Standard/RTU (veteran, age factor, depends on health) → approved or referred
underwriting_paths.john_senior_55: Standard/RTU (civilian, age 55+, higher risk) → approved or referred
underwriting_paths.patricia_warren_61: RTU/Declined (age 61, retired military, highest risk factors) → referred or declined

certified_invariants: the dashboard heading echoes the logged-in member's name (identity_echo)
the beneficiary COUNT is member-derived (cardinality varies by behavior class)
policy number and coverage are member-derived; the page chrome/labels are app-constant
member lookup auto-populates personal information from the profile (pre-populated fields)
underwriting decision is computed from actual health+lifestyle answers (not random/hardcoded)
primary beneficiary percentages must sum to exactly 100%
electronic signature requires typed name to match the applicant's legal name
grading: a correct E2E crawl captures all 19 pages, identifies conditional UI branches (health follow-ups, payment method toggle, replacement policy conditional), records underwriting decision path, and distinguishes member-derived values from app-constant chrome across the full quote-to-application journey.
